message: 本当の試練

name: Lolotte
message: 「Phew. That was quite an ordeal~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, it's good that we wrapped it up quickly before the crucial Holy Night Festival.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now we can throw ourselves into Student Council activities with peace of mind.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I'm itching for action!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone's in high spirits\s07 Then I suppose you're all set for next week's regular exams too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Ria-senpai. What did you just say?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ex-ams.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I completely forgot about theeeeeeem!」

name: Misa
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Whoa, Misa-chan. Hang in there!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait, wait! It's too soon to give up! If we start right now--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The exams... are over...」

name: Synn
message: 「They haven't even started yet!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-What should we do.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Like, maybe find a way to travel back in time.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeees, leave it to me and rest assured! Demon World Mail-Order~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「No you don't, Synn-kun. Don't try to escape reality.」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But... if we ever end up getting bad grades on the exams--」

name: Helena
message: 「You got so wrapped up in Student Council activities that you neglected your primary duties as students...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Any joke of an organization like that is disbanded immediately!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What if something like that happens!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun. With the Student Council's dignity on the line, let's compete--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is this the time for that?! Everyone will just have to teach us step by step!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm... Indeed.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, 'step by step' sounds so embarrassing!\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then what are we supposed to do?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Why don't we all study together?」

name: Everyone
message: 「That's it!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! This Student Council has three people with top-of-the-grade brains, doesn't it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We have the weekend before the exams, too. If everyone teaches us, there won't be any problems.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey!! If we spend all our time teaching you guys, we won't get any studying done ourselves!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine! Even if your grades drop a little, as long as you don't fail, it's all good!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not the issue! Right, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... Usually I'm fine because I prep and review. But lately I haven't done any at all...」

name: Misa
message: 「Pull yourself together, you're supposed to be my rival, aren't you?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Anyway, we're counting on you, President!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All right. Then tomorrow after school... it's a study session at Synn's house!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh, Nanaka-chan's all fired up♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course I am! My grades are directly linked to my allowance!」

name: Synn
message: 「Which equals sweets, huh...」
Thus, the battle with everyone's Student Council lives on the line suddenly began.
